meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会使用 geniml 处理 BED 基因组区间数据：验证 BED 和 universe 是否符合约定，规划 Region2Vec 或 scEmbed 训练，检查模型与 tokenizer 的兼容性，评估 consensus universes。
howto.when: 当你说到 BED 文件、Region2Vec、scEmbed 等关键词，或要求对基因组区间做机器学习分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练这批 BED 文件的区域嵌入。
say.note: 会规划并运行 tokenization 和模型训练。

say.text: 用 scEmbed 分析这个 scATAC-seq 数据并进行细胞聚类。
say.note: 会准备 AnnData、预分词、训练模型并生成嵌入。

say.text: 从这些 BED 文件构建一个 consensus universe。
say.note: 会生成 coverage 并选择方法构建 universe。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will use geniml to handle genomic interval data from BED files: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, check model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like BED files, Region2Vec, scEmbed, etc., or ask for machine-learning analysis of genomic intervals.

say_en.text: Help me train region embeddings for these BED files using Region2Vec.
say_en.note: Will plan and run tokenization and model training.

say_en.text: Analyze this scATAC-seq data with scEmbed and cluster cells.
say_en.note: Will prepare AnnData, pre-tokenize, train model, and generate embeddings.

say_en.text: Build a consensus universe from these BED files.
say_en.note: Will generate coverage and build universe using a chosen method.
